article.title: Stensul檢查電郵優惠是否易被AI讀取，摘要預覽仍待推出
article.title_en: Stensul checks whether email offers are AI-readable; summary preview remains planned
article.summary: Stensul新增寄送前AI優惠可讀性檢查及Gmail促銷註記，摘要預覽則計劃於2027年初推出。
article.summary_en: Stensul added pre-send AI offer-readability checks and Gmail Promotions annotations; summary preview is planned for early 2027.
highlights: 檢查優惠藏在圖片、欠缺預覽文字及主旨與正文不一致等問題。
促銷註記按電郵設定並由管理員授權；現有功能並非Gmail摘要模擬器。
highlights_en: Checks flag image-only offers, missing preheaders and subject-body mismatches.
Annotations are set per email under admin controls; the current feature is not a Gmail summary simulator.
article.why: 優惠可讀性加入寄送前檢查後，電郵團隊可決定哪些圖片優惠須補成文字，以及哪些促銷資料需要逐封更新。
article.why_en: Pre-send readability checks help email teams identify offers needing live text and promotion details requiring per-message updates.
article.next_step: 取同一優惠的圖片版與文字版，檢查兩者是否被指出缺漏，再核對主旨、預覽文字、促銷碼及到期日是否一致。
article.next_step_en: Compare image-only and live-text versions of one offer, then reconcile subject, preheader, promo code and expiry date before approval.
article.detail: QA即寄送前的品質檢查。消息按Business Wire公司新聞稿整理，原公告日期是11月23日，而非其他網站轉載日期。這次檢查重點是讓優惠資料可讀，不能保證Gmail一定採用某段摘要或促銷呈現。編輯建議把修訂原因記在電郵版本旁，保留正式批准環節；2027年初的預覽計劃與已提供的檢查功能應分開評估。
article.detail_en: QA means quality assurance before sending. This report follows the November 23 issuer release, not later republication dates. Readable offers do not guarantee a particular Gmail summary or display. Record revisions alongside email versions and retain approval; evaluate the planned 2027 preview separately from current checks.
